items.source: Enables Spring's core resilience features for method invocations: @Retryable as well as @ConcurrencyLimit.
items.translation: 启用 Spring 核心弹性功能，用于方法调用：`@Retryable`（org.springframework.resilience.annotation 包中的注解接口）以及 `@ConcurrencyLimit`。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a retry interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @Retryable.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@Retryable注解的 bean 方法应用重试拦截器。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a concurrency interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @ConcurrencyLimit.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@ConcurrencyLimit注解的 bean 方法应用并发拦截器。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers the Spring infrastructure beans necessary to enable proxy-based method invocations with retry and concurrency limit behavior.
items.translation: @Configuration 类，用于注册启用基于代理的方法调用（具有重试和并发限制行为）所需的 Spring 基础设施 Bean。

items.source: Annotation-based retry and concurrency limit support.
items.translation: 基于注解的重试和并发限制支持。

items.source:
A common annotation specifying a concurrency limit for an individual method,
or for all proxy-invoked methods in a given class hierarchy if annotated at
the type level.
items.translation: 指定单个方法并发限制，或如果在类型级别上标注，则指定给定类层次结构中所有代理调用方法的公共注解。

items.source:
A common annotation specifying retry characteristics for an individual method,
or for all proxy-invoked methods in a given class hierarchy if annotated at
the type level.
items.translation: 指定单个方法的重试特性，或在类型级别上注解时指定给定类层次结构中所有代理调用方法的重试特性的通用注解。
